batting.name: PD Collingwood
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b BAW Mendis

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b AB Dinda

batting.name: KM Jadhav
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b BAW Mendis

balls.text: full toss! and Angelo slaps it wide of long-on fielder. No chance to cut it off. Gambhir is unhappy and kicks the ground in disgust as he walks off.
really full delivery on the off stump line, lifted one bounce to long-off
presses back, opens his stance and pulls a length delivery to wide midwicket region. Whack!
moves down the track and whips it to deep midwicket
Blasted! He moved outside leg and thrashed the really full delivery to left of long-off
goes down the track but Mishy bowls a yorker.. the front-of-the-hand slider .. dug out to the off side
fetches the slower one from outside off and swings it to left of deep midwicket
moves down the track and off drives to long-off
The new piece of wood works. He picks the slower one from his Sri Lankan team-mate and crashes it over long-on.
on the off stump line, Tiwary had shuffled right across but is beaten by the slower one .. he just about jabs it to the on side
really full delivery, stabbed to cover
shovelled through midwicket for couple of runs
around 123 kmph low full toss on the middle stump line, Tiwary blasts it over long-on boundary. Two full tosses in this over have been put away
slower one outside off stump, Angelo goes for the big lofted shot but ends up dragging it to midwicket region
SWAT! Low full toss on middle and Angelo swats it to the cowcorner
around 105 kmph really slow delivery, Angelo is through early with his pull and the ball bounces once before it reaches the keeper
reaches out to drive to right of long-off
fullish, delivery, he ended up slicing his lofted drive and the ball curved away towards long-off .. it appeared to be going to the on side initially but shaped away
moves down the track but Mishy is ready for him and that move as he drops it on the blockhole! Just about dug out
threatens to go down the track, Mishra pushes it well outside off to stump him,. the batsman reaches out to jab it to cover
on the middle stump line, slides across, defended on the front foot
moves down the track and ends up slicing it over point
fine leg break, dips outside off and spins past the defensive poke ... DK takes the bails off in flash but Angelo had pushed his back foot back inside the crease in time
rushes down the track, doesn't quite reach the pitch of the googly but goes through with the lofted hit over long-on and the ball sails over
quickish, just outside off stump, jabbed out to cover
quick one, moving in with the arm again, pushed out to the off side.
the arm-ball on the off stump line, eased back to Dan
slows up the pace even further, Angelo goes down the track and drives wide of long-on
loopy flighted delivery on leg and middle, rolls off the pad
yet another slower one, pushed towards long-on
leans forward to push it to cover for a single
Dropped by Rajat Bhatia Low dipping full toss was scooped back to Rajat who stretches his right hand out but fails to hold on
on the middle stump, as ever another slower one, worked past square-leg
lunges towards the off side and plays a paddle scoop. Vettori makes a good stop near the fine-leg boundary
worked through midwicket towards Sangwan for a single
wide outside leg stump
moves down the track, tapes the ball past square-leg and this time they don't attempt the second run. Rajat Bhatia rushes in from the deep and flicks the ball to the keeper
on the off and middle line, eased towards midwicket and the bowler himself sets off in pursuit
worked away for a single
on the middle stump line, eased wide of long-on
Again, that really slow delivery from Dan.. it looped outside off stump.. Tiwary goes for the sweep and top edges it over the keeper. Bhatia makes a fine tumbling stop near the boundary

McCullum is run out A big wicket. It was pushed towards deep square-leg .. Rajat Bhatia rushes in and fires in the throw to Dan, who very calmly breaks the stumps. They managed to steal two runs in the last over when McCullum tapped past square-leg but that was hit far more gently than this one.
swatted past square-leg
outside off stump, yeah another slower one, Tiwary tries to late cut but can't connect
low full toss, hit straight towards Warner at long-off
on the leg stump line, turned behind square-leg
yet another slower one, full and around off, pushed out to long-off
slower one, on the middle stump line, tapped past square-leg and by the time the man comes in from the deep, the batsmen complete two runs
leans forward to push it to cover

What a loverly delivery! Slow. Really slow. It was looped across. Ganguly had to wait and wait on the front foot and tried to adjust by attempting a slog sweep .. but he had completed the shot far too early. The ball gently eased towards the middle stump.
drifts down leg, rolls off the pad to short fine-leg region
quicker one, Ganguly punches it down to long-on. Not quite well timed and he has a close look at his bat
on the leg and middle line, slower, flighted, eased out to long-on
stays back to punch it to long-off
another slower one, Ganguly takes the bottom-hand off the handle to push it out to cover
reaches his fifty with a boundary to third-man region. It was pushed outside off stump, he reached out to cut and it rushes off the bottom edge of the bat.
The slower ones keep coming .. pushed through cover point

run out chance around 114 kmph leg cutter outside off, guided to backward point.. McCullum was rushing for a risky single and is sent back. He turns and sees Sangwan with the throw. And he rushes and throws in a splendid dive to get back to his crease

Done in by the slower one! Rajat keeps faith on his slower ones and slips in one full and on the off stump line. Gayle, who went over long-on last ball, tried to slog this one too square on the leg side and that led to his down fall. The bat whooshed past the ball .. Clatter!

HUGE! Ganyle cleared the front foot, waited for the slower one and walloped it high over long-on. The ball is gone into the rubble - that part of the stadium is being under reconstruction-  and seems to have got dirty. What a thunderous wallop that was.
turns in from outside leg .. Colly has been essentially an off-break bowler this game, tapped out to deep midwicket
down the leg side and DK collects
yet another slower one, Ganguly was down the track, had to wait and pushes it out to long-off
moves outside leg, Colly follows him with a slower one, pushed out to extra cover
slower one, fullish, just outside leg, tapped past midwicket
moves outside leg stump and punches it to long-off
Flamboyant!  Ganguly rushes down the track and lifts it to the straight boundary.
yet another slower one, on the middle and off, forced to sweeper cover
slower one, on the middle and off line, Ganguly moves outside leg and mistimes the shot back to the bowler
moves down the track for the lofted hit but goes through early with the shot and edges it to backward square-leg
slower one around off stump, guided to point region for a single
just outside off stump, punched out to cover where a tumbling stop is made
short in length and outside off, Gayle stays back to flat bat it to long-off

threatens to move outside leg before returning back to the leg stump .. Colly tries to push this one quicker and Ganguly opens the bat-face to flash his square drive well to the left of short third man fielder
slower one again, turns in from outside leg, tapped to square-leg
lands outside leg on a length, breaks back in, punched away wide of Warner at long-on
gets forward to push it out to cover
moves down the track and flicks it to deep backward square-leg
starts off with a slower one, eased through covers
The leg-stump line which worked against Ganguly in the last over has failed him here with Gayle. Another fierce sweep shot, another boundary.
floats this one full and well outside leg stump, a googly Gayle takes his one hand off the handle to complete the sweep shot.
another front-of-the-hand slider on the leg stump line, jabbed out to midwicket
around leg stump, doesn't connect well with the sweep
Fabulicious Wallop! He just leaned forward and lifted the slider up and over long-on
short in length, again just around the leg stump , forced away to deep midwicket

sharp good yorker on the leg stump line, Gayle almost loses balance in trying to get his front foot out of the way and he just about manages to get bat to ball. Lucky fat edge, though and the ball rushes past short fine-leg fielder
slower one outside off stump, pushed out to the off side
walks to  the off side and works it from outside off to long-on ..
shuffles across and mistimes the drive to mid-off
full in length ,Ganguly gets across to drive it crisply but Gambhir cuts it off in the covers
really full delivery, Ganguly clears the front foot and drives it to between bowler and mid-on.
flatter googly, pushed out to the on side
leans forward to push the flighted leg break to mid-off
What a googly! Ripper! Ganguly is beaten comprehensively. IT landed outside leg stump and spun away, past Ganguly .. Loverly!
again the outside-leg line, GAnguly is hit on the pad again. .
pushes another wide down the leg side
moves outside leg, Mishra follows him with a full delivery, Ganguly tries to sweep and is hit on the pad
the slider on the middle, worked to midwicket
pushes it full and outside leg stump. Ganguly tries a sweep shot but doesn't connect
tries the well outside-off line to Gayle as well. Gayle just reaches out and slices it over short third man fielder
really full again, pushed out wide of cover
for the first time, a straight ball, really full, Ganguly walked down the track, almost yorked himself and dug it out to the on side
slower, again well outside off, fullish, driven to cover
outside off stump, pushed out to point region .
wide outside off stump and this time Ganguly lets it go.
short and wide, Ganguly reaches out and cuts but straight to backward point. He has missed out on an great opportunity to collect a boundary
Yet another slower one, Gayle picks it early, waits for it to arrive, opens the bat-face and guides it to left of short third man
slower one again from Maharoof, around off stump, guided to right of Rajat Bhatia at short third man
steered to backward point, one look at Gayle who responds quickly. Ganguly reaches the other end and applauds Gayle for responding favorably to his call
on the off and middle stump line, pushed out to short mid-off region .. Gambhir rushes from straightish short cover to cut it off
low full toss outside leg stump and Ganguly chooses to be gentle with it. He eases it past short fine-leg fielder

length delivery cutting from middle and leg line towards middle, jabbed out to the off side of the pitch .. Maharoof lunges across but fails to cut it of and they steal the single as the ball rolls to left of mid-off
on the leg stump again and Ganguly plays a sweep shot. Meaty!
slows up the pace, loops it across but pushes it down the leg side
skips down the track and drives through covers. He timed his  jump down the track to perfection
goes for the sweep but deosn't connect

goes on with the arm .. slides away from Ganguly - a good ball actually but Ganguly shows his class.  He was pressing forward, picked the floater, held his balance, waited, opened the bat-face and unfurled a lovely late cut. Yummy!
on the off stump line, pushed out to cover point
on the middle and leg line, eased to deep midwicket
yet another slower one, tapped close on the off side and they get across for the single
Slower one ..Ganguly is flummoxed, he was again coming down the track, the ball goes past the waft and over the off stump
He backed away even as he stepped out of his crease, Maharoof tried to follow him but Ganguly still manages to slice it up and over point.
opens the bat-face to steer the slower one to point
full in length, just outside off stump, Ganguly eases it wide of cover fielder for a single. Oh .. super timing .. he will get couple of runs. Neat
full in length, cutting away from the middle stump line, Ganguly squeezes it out to covers
Ganguly's boys have done it. KKR win by 14 runs. For the record the final delivery was full pitched on the leg and Dan turned it to fine-leg boundary.
goes for another yorker, ends up a low inswinging full delivery, takes the edge and rolls away to short fine-leg
screaming yorker length delivery outside off, Mishra can't get bat to ball. Saha collects
full delivery, short of the blockhole but pretty close up there.. edged to the on side
another low full toss, Dan smashes it to the straight boundary
low full toss outside off, drievn to long-off for a single
goes for another yorker, low dipping full toss, Mishra fails to connect with the slog .. the ball rolls to left of the keeper. What a super over from Dinda
almost yorker length, steered to third man
moves outside leg, Dinda pushes it wide outside off stump .. he tried a slower one but ended up pushing it too far across
the slower one outside off, Mishra edges the intended big hit to the off side
the slow bouncer on the leg stump line, Mishra had backed outside leg, tries to steer it to third man but fails

surely, game over now?! DK went for the swing across the line but dragged it straight to midwicket. Dinda, who started the damage by taking out the off stump of David Warner, has returned to take out DK
moves right across his sticks, Dinda follows him with a full delivery, tapped to the on side for a single
really full delivery on the legs, turned past square-leg for a single
on the off and middle, DK goes for his favourite slog sweep but just a single

Bhatia is run out  Iqbal Abdulla you beauty! It was pushed to the short mid-off region .. Abdulla charged out, slid towards the ball, picked it up and fired a direct hit at the non-striker's end! KKR edge ahead
lunges out to scoop the flighted delivery wide of long-on
Ganguly is hype active today. He dives to his left at short cover to make another stop
Clatterrrrrrr! the stumps are in a disarray and Eden Gardens is screaming in delight. Maharoof went for the slog sweep but no wood on leather. Timber!
on the leg and middle line, pushed to short mid-on region for a single. What a fine over this from Mendis.
goes for the slog sweep, doesn't connect properly and will pick up a single
leans forward to drive to long-off
Dada is rocking out there tonight! It was smashed over his head at short cover but he calmly jumps up to pouch it. Mendis has struck. Eden Gardens, as you would expect, has gone gaga
loopy delivery on the middle and leg, pushed past square-leg
moves down the track and stabs the carrom ball back to the bowler
full and around off stump, dabbed to left of Gayle at short third man
turns away from the middle and off line, Jadhav tries to whip it across the line and is beaten
on driven to wide of long-on .. Dk slipped and so settled for a single . Jadhav was down the track and had to get back
Fab strike. He opens-up his stance, places his front leg well outside leg and pulls it to the wide midwicket boundary
worked wide of midwicket for a single
Gangoolee! It was cut hard to his left at short cover and he makes a fine diving stop and nearly affects a run out at the non-striker's end!
the slower bouncer, outside off, Jadhav helps it along, sort of upper cuts it, to left of third man
Ajiteyyyyyy! Chopped on! twist twist twist! Fullish inswinger outside off, Sehwag was backing away to play the big off drive and the late swing meant the ball took the fatal inside edge
reaches across to outside off and carves to point boundary

Full toss outside off, Sehwag has a swing and miss. And oh dear he would have been out had SAha hit the stumps with his throw.. sehwag was almost absentmindedly straying outside the crease after he played that shot..
smashes this one to long-on
DK steps forward, walks down the track and plays a classy pick-up shot to wide midwicket boundary.
gets down on his knee to play the sweep shot
leans forward to off drive to wide of long-off
backs away to the on side and cuts it for a single
spins away from the middle and off line, gets past the poke and rolls away to the off side
gets forward to tap it to vacant spaces in midwicket region and they run hard to complete two
Thrash! Sehwag picks the slower one early and swings it high over the cowcorner. Immense!
slow off cutter on the middle stump line, turned to long-leg
slower one, full, turned to short midwicket
short in length outside off, cut away to backward point .. throw comes in at non-striker's end where Angelo fails to collect it
slower one, turned to right of short fine-leg where Gayle makes a diving half-stop
bangs it in short and Sehwag pulls it to wide midwicket boundary. Sehwag's seventh IPL fifty!
full delivery, sliding in, DK pushes it to short midwicket
gets forward to push it to the on side
Dropped by Saha, the keeper It skid on outside off stump, Sehwag went for the cut and bottom-edged it .. Saha stood up early and clanged it! Oh but never mind it .. the umpire has given it as a byes!
Mendis takes out Colly and Ganguly is delighted! Done in by the googly! Collingwood picked it very late and chipped it straight to deep midwicket
shortish delivery outside off, swung down to long-on
full in length outside off, pushed out to deep cover
length delivery around the off stump line, pushed out towards cover
another lifting delivery, Sehwag swats it past square-leg
the bouncer on the middle stump line and Sehwag ducks.
Gambhir is run out Ganguly with the direct hit! He moved forward from mid-off to cut off the off drive and threw down the stumps at the non-striker's end. Gone!
tries the short delivery around middle stump line and Gambhir pulls it away to th square-leg boundary. Thrash.
fullish outside off, Gambhir swings to the long-on boundary
lands this on the yorker on middle stump line, Sehwag manages to dig it out at the last second
on the leg stump line, dabbed to square-leg
Skilful! rushes down the track and swings it to wide midwicket boundary.
low full toss and Gambhir picks his spot and chips it to over midwicket ..
stays back to force it to long-on
on the leg stump line, eased to deep square-leg
slower one, pushed out to right of the fielder at covers
short in length on the off and middle, punched through the off side
full in length outside off, driven towards long-off
the slower leg cutter, pulled away to deep midwicket
pushes it down the leg side ..
Crash! He cleared the front foot and knifed it through the line, up and over long-off
around off stump line, guided to short third man
dropped by Iqbal Abdulla at deep midwicket. Tough chance. Sehwag lifted it towards Abdulla who dived forward but couldn't get his palms under the ball.
just outside off, Sehwag plays the late cut and Gayle rushes to his left at short third-man to make a diving half-stop
quickish, skids on towards middle and leg, tapped to midwicket
skips down the track and drives through covers
goes down the track and punches it through midwicket
pushes this one down the leg side
moves down the track and turns it through midwicket
driven to left of long-on and they complete two runs. The second run seemed risky but Gambhir just about makes it back in time.
how many is too many? Yet another full toss and finally, Sehwag puts one away. He flicks it to backward square-leg boundary
slower one outside off stump, run down to third man
another low full toss, driven straight to long-off
low full toss this time, driven to right of sweeper cover
slower one outside off stump line, Sehwag unfurls the square drive and plays it to perfection
hits it hard to left of long-on for a single
short , pulled straight to deep square-leg .. Gambhir quite unhappy with himself for not hitting it to the boundary
moves outside leg stump, Mendis follows him, punched to long-on
moves down the track and drives the carrom ball to mid-off
on the leg stump line, dabbed past square-leg
moves outside leg stump and square drives and Tiwary makes yet another fine diving half-stop moving to his right at backward point
Thunderous! Full delivery on the middle stump line has been walloped over midwicket boundary.
moves outside leg stump, Angelo tries to follow him with a short-of-length delivery and Gambhir moves further away to slap it past point
fullish on the middle and off, Gambhir swings it across the line to wide midwicket boundary
on the leg and middle line, slower short in lengthdelivery, goes past the attempted pull and goes off the pad
connects with the pull shot this time and gets a single
Angelo starts off with a bouncer, Gambhir was walking down the track and was in trouble. He tried to go through with the pull but the ball had flashed past his helmet by then
bouncing delivery outside off, Sehwag walks out to attempt an slog and the keeper collects
short in length and outside off, Sehwag flashes it to third man boundary
short in length on the middle and leg , pushed out to mid-on
fires a bouncer on the leg stump line .. Sehwag allows it to pass his left shoulder
slower one, on the leg stump line, turned past square-leg
goes down the track, moves outside leg and Agarkar shortens the length .. Gambhir tries the cut but the ball flies over the blade
on that leg stump line, just pitched outside leg and strikes Gambhir on the pad. Appeal for lbw but guess it just landed outside leg
pushes this one out to the off side
Whippy! It was the short-of-length delivery on off and middle, And Sehwag uses that length to play a fine whippy shot through midwicket
Sehwag shapes for a cover drive.. checks his shot and almost scoops to cover .. where McCullum dives full stretch forward but doesn't reach the ball
dabbed to square-leg for a run
pushed out to the on side for a single

Huge appeal for a catch behind decision and turned down .. Was Rudi shaping to lift his finger .... he seemed to be giving his slow death but just about stops his finger! GAnguly can't believe it. It was the full delivery outside off, Sehwag went for the big off drive and there was some noise but just one replay so far and one is not sure whether there was any edge ...
goes for the really full one, Sehwag tries to whip it away, misses and the ball rolls of the pad
short in length outside off and Gambhir cuts hard but Manoj Tiwary makes a fine diving half- stop to his left at backward point
stays back to punch it to right of mid-off
Six over third man! Sehwag special! It was the lifting delivery outside off stump, Sehwag arched back and played a delicious upper cut! Fab!
works this length delivery wide of midwicket for a single
leans forward to jab out a full delivery to mid-off
full in length on the leg and middle, clipped past square-leg.

Dindaaaaaaa! The off stump has been knocked out. Eden Gardens roars! Warner, who was troubled through the over by Dinda, is gone. Another quick skiddy delivery from short-of-length on the middle and off stump line .. Warner shapes for that short-arm pull but is beaten by the skidding pace. Clatterrrrrrr!

skids on quickly from short of length towards leg stump, seems to be a plan and is working fine by the look of things. Again Warner is hurried on by the skiddy pace and yet again, fails to connect with his short-mar pull
lands short of length, on middle and leg, skids on at around 138 kmph, towards middle, Warner edges the attempted short-arm jab to the on side
on the middle and leg, skiddy, pushed out to point
short in length, skidding towards leg stump line, Warner tries to short-arm pull and is hit on the thigh pad
